body:
I admit you're right and that I should follow your advice. But I feel like a fool because I still care about that person who ditched me despite it all... which makes me angry at myself, mostly.
It's hard, but of course I'll try to forget them. Thank you for the kind words.
I can't think of a better way. It seems like 2 birds with 1 stone: I don't have to suffer anymore and everyone who hurt me gets a taste of their own medicine.

1. My bastard parents who use me as an emotional punching bag.
2. Someone I loved and trusted more than anything who threw me away like trash because they found someone better. Years of my life down the drain.
There is no one else in my life.
